mapper.insert: INSERT INTO test_chain_version (chain_code, chain_fingerprint, version, chain_name, execute_mode, description, node_snapshot, diff_result, ai_analysis, status, create_by) VALUES (#{chainCode}, #{chainFingerprint}, #{version}, #{chainName}, #{executeMode}, #{description}, #{nodeSnapshot}, #{diffResult}, #{aiAnalysis}, #{status}, #{createBy})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM test_chain_version WHERE chain_code = #{chainCode} AND version = #{version}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) FROM test_chain_version WHERE chain_code = #{chainCode}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_chain_version WHERE chain_code = #{chainCode}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM test_chain_version WHERE chain_code = #{chainCode} AND version = #{version}
DELETE FROM test_chain_version WHERE chain_code = #{chainCode} AND version <= #{version}
